boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Molloy University
boards.description: Ten food-forward Rockville Centre destinations with currently published evening hours, suitable for an under-21 late-night plan.

cards.title: Saltano's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 2 N Park Ave, Rockville Centre — open as late as 3:30 AM Friday and Sunday
cards.notes: Check the takeout-hours panel before leaving, then place a pickup order or stop in for pizza, calzones, garlic knots, and other Italian fare.
cards.short_summary: A North Park Avenue pizza stop with the latest posted takeout hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Saltano's official ordering page lists its Rockville Centre address and takeout hours through 3:30 AM on Friday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official takeout hours: Tuesday–Wednesday until 11 PM; Thursday and Saturday until midnight; Friday and Sunday until 3:30 AM.

cards.title: 3 Brothers of RVC
cards.subtitle: 285 Merrick Rd, Rockville Centre — posted open until midnight Monday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's order link or call ahead, especially close to midnight, for vegan and traditional pizza options at the Merrick Road location.
cards.short_summary: A pizza café with posted midnight service most nights of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: 3 Brothers' official site identifies its 285 Merrick Road location and says it is open 11 AM to midnight Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Saturday 11 AM–midnight and Sunday 11 AM–10 PM; verify holiday changes before travel.

cards.title: Mojo RVC
cards.subtitle: 300 Sunrise Highway, Rockville Centre — late-night service Friday and Saturday until 2 AM
cards.notes: Consult Mojo's current menu-and-hours page and use its contact details for a late-night food plan; the page lists dinner, dessert, and late-night menus.
cards.short_summary: A Sunrise Highway restaurant that explicitly posts Friday and Saturday late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Mojo RVC's official menu page lists 300 Sunrise Highway and states late night runs Friday and Saturday until 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page says late-night service runs Friday and Saturday until 2 AM; dinner hours vary by day.

cards.title: Pappa Gallo
cards.subtitle: 273 Sunrise Highway, Rockville Centre — dinner listed until 1 AM Thursday
cards.notes: Review the official dinner menu and day-specific hours before making plans; Thursday is the latest posted restaurant closing time on the page.
cards.short_summary: A Rockville Centre Peruvian restaurant with a Thursday 1 AM posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Pappa Gallo's official menu page lists 273 Sunrise Highway and Thursday hours of 5 PM to 1 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Thursday 5 PM–1 AM; Friday and Saturday dining to midnight, with separate bar hours noted.

cards.title: Cabo RVC
cards.subtitle: 3A North Park Avenue, Rockville Centre — open until 1 AM Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's official hours page to choose a food visit; weekday service is listed later than midnight, with later Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.short_summary: A North Park Avenue Mexican restaurant with posted 1 AM weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cabo RVC's official site lists its 3A North Park Avenue address and hours until 1 AM Monday through Thursday and 2 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 1 PM–1 AM Monday–Thursday, 1 PM–2 AM Friday–Saturday, and 1 PM–11 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Abu Zayn
cards.subtitle: 280 Merrick Rd, Rockville Centre — Friday and Saturday hours until 11 PM
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner around the restaurant's posted 11 PM close, and use its menu page to check the current address and contact details.
cards.short_summary: An Egyptian restaurant on Merrick Road with late Friday and Saturday dining hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Abu Zayn's official site lists 280 Merrick Road and Friday–Saturday hours from 11 AM to 11 PM.
cards.source_title: Abu Zayn — Rockville Centre Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Monday–Thursday 11 AM–10 PM, Friday–Saturday 11 AM–11 PM, Sunday noon–9 PM.

cards.title: Golden Reef Diner
cards.subtitle: 329 Sunrise Highway, Rockville Centre — official site currently lists service until 10 PM
cards.notes: Use the diner’s direct ordering option or call before heading over, as its official site provides both pickup information and its current daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Sunrise Highway diner with a direct pickup option and posted 10 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Reef Diner's official site lists 329 Sunrise Highway in Rockville Centre and states that it is open until 10 PM today.
cards.source_title: Golden Reef Diner — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: The official site’s live hours panel lists 8 AM–10 PM; confirm the day’s hours directly before travel.

cards.title: Churchills
cards.subtitle: 18 South Park Avenue, Rockville Centre — Friday and Saturday dining until 10 PM
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s day-by-day hours before setting out; its official page also offers takeout alongside indoor and outdoor dining.
cards.short_summary: A South Park Avenue food stop with 10 PM Friday and Saturday dining hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Churchills' official site lists 18 South Park Avenue, takeout availability, and Friday–Saturday operating hours until 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Tuesday–Thursday until 9 PM, Friday–Saturday until 10 PM, and Sunday until 9 PM.

cards.title: Gino's Rockville Centre
cards.subtitle: 187 N Long Beach Rd, Rockville Centre — open until 10 PM Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: For a weekend evening pickup, use Gino's official ordering link or call the listed number; the site posts its full daily hours for this location.
cards.short_summary: A Long Beach Road pizzeria with a clearly posted 10 PM weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's official site identifies 187 N Long Beach Road in Rockville Centre and lists Friday and Saturday hours until 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official store hours list 11 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday; other days close at 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Anselma Room
cards.subtitle: Molloy University campus — weekday service listed until 9 PM during full service
cards.notes: Check Lessing’s campus dining page before relying on it, then use mobile ordering or visit the Anselma Room while its current weekday evening service is running.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus dining room with current weekday evening service posted by Molloy’s dining operator.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy's campus dining operator lists the Anselma Room at Molloy University and weekday full-service hours of 7 AM to 9 PM.
cards.source_title: Molloy University Campus Café — Menus, Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: The official dining page lists full-service weekday hours of 7 AM–9 PM; service dates and hours on the page may change by academic period.
